title: Find the First F
description: Play the leftmost F3 key five times, releasing it between notes.
hint: The far-left white key is F3. Tap the highlighted first key.
spokenInstructions: Welcome to Piano Play Lab! Let's find F three. It's the white key on the far left of your little piano. Watch it glow yellow. Press that key five times, lifting your finger between each press. Listen for a happy chime when you get it right!

title: Five-Finger Walk
description: Walk from F3 to C4 and back, one note at a time.
hint: Play F3, G3, A3, B♭3, C4, then back to F3.
spokenInstructions: Time for a five-finger walk! We will play F three, G three, A three, B flat three, and C four. Then we'll walk back down. Watch the glowing key and play just one note at a time. The B flat key is black. You can go as slowly as you like!

title: A Little Melody
description: Try a short tune using keys in the first octave of your toy piano.
hint: Find the highlighted key and play each note in turn.
spokenInstructions: Let's play a little melody! Follow the yellow key as it changes. Sometimes we play the same note twice. When that happens, lift your finger and play it again. Listen to the next note if you need help. Ready? Let's make music!

title: High and Low F
description: Hear and play F in three different registers on your toy piano.
hint: Play the leftmost F3, F4 in the middle, and rightmost F5.
spokenInstructions: Let's explore high and low sounds! Begin with F three, the white key at the far left. Then find F four, one octave higher, and F five, at the far right. Play F four again, and finish on F three. Can you hear the difference?

title: Twinkle Twinkle Little Star
description: Play Twinkle Twinkle and the beginning of its next phrase. A gentle beginner excerpt in F major.
hint: Start on F4 (the middle F); follow the gold notes. B♭4 is a black key.
spokenInstructions: Let's play Twinkle Twinkle Little Star! Start with the F key near the middle of your piano. Play each glowing note one at a time. First, tap Hear whole melody so you know how the tune sounds. Then follow the golden keys. Some notes repeat, so lift your finger between them. Take your time!

title: Wheels on the Bus · Traditional Tune
description: Play an easy instrumental passage using the old Mulberry Bush melody commonly sung with Wheels on the Bus.
hint: Start on C5. The melody repeats notes and moves by small steps.
spokenInstructions: Let's go for a musical bus ride! This lesson uses a traditional tune often sung with The Wheels on the Bus. Listen to the whole melody first, then find C five and play along with the glowing keys. Keep the short repeated notes light and bouncy. You can go at your own speed!

title: Puppy Rescue Parade · Original
description: An original adventure melody for rescue-pup fans. This is not the television show's theme music.
hint: Begin on F4 and follow the rising notes, then play the little descending phrase.
spokenInstructions: Calling all rescue puppies! Let's play a brand new puppy rescue melody. It has a bouncy, brave sound, and it is our own tune, not the Paw Patrol television theme. Hear the full melody, then follow the golden keys. Can you make it to the end of the rescue mission?

title: Ice Cream Truck · The Entertainer
description: A short, beginner-friendly excerpt inspired by Scott Joplin's public-domain ragtime tune, The Entertainer.
hint: Start on G4. Listen for the playful G4–A4–F4 opening before you play.
spokenInstructions: Do you hear the ice cream truck? This lesson plays a short, simplified bit of The Entertainer, an old ragtime tune that ice cream trucks sometimes play. It starts on G four. Listen to the whole melody, then follow the notes on your piano. This one has a bouncy rhythm!

title: Mary Had a Little Lamb
description: A short, traditional beginner melody. Practice stepping down and up between neighbouring keys.
hint: Start on A4 and step down to G4 and F4.
spokenInstructions: Let's play Mary Had a Little Lamb! Start on A four. Walk down one key to G four, then down to F four, and come back up. Listen to the melody first, then follow the golden key as each note appears. Excellent!
